parsed_result.rationale: The fallback scanner lives in src/indexer/symbols.rs. extract_symbols first tries tree_sitter_symbols::extract_symbols and falls back to extract_symbols_fallback when tree-sitter returns None or an empty symbol list. The fallback line scanner extracts Rust fn/struct/enum/trait/impl/mod, JavaScript and TypeScript function/class/interface/type plus const/let/var as function or constant, Python def/class, and additional non-tree-sitter languages. src/indexer/tree_sitter_symbols.rs shows tree-sitter is only wired for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Rust, so other code languages use the fallback path. src/indexer/mod.rs stores fallback RawSymbol values as SymbolRecord entries in the local index. tests/cli.rs covers indexed symbols for non-tree-sitter languages and command output, while symbols.rs has unit coverage for Rust, Python, and TypeScript extraction. Notable gap: the Rust fallback parser does not include const/static constant extraction, even though tree_sitter_symbols.rs handles Rust const_item as kind constant.
